typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		KEYWORD_NAME as string,
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsotradekeywordFeedRedid
fromcalypsotradekeywordFeedRedid derive({FEED_REDID$} = KEYWORD_VALUE,
		{TRADE_ID$} = toString(TRADE_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		trade_id as string,
		keyword_value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		trade_id = {TRADE_ID$},
		keyword_value = {FEED_REDID$}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tocalypsotradeservtkeywordfeedredid
